about_the_game:
There's more than just looks to take into account when planning your build, or don't, going down in style is also a valid way to play our game.

Plan the best way to use your resources you got from selling your stolen treasures and prioritize which defences you need for the incoming nightly horde of monsters, strategically place down barriers, traps and turrets to defend your base, and if worse comes to worst, arm yourself with a sword and shield and stand at the ready for you final stand.



Prepare yourself to enter the abyss of the deepest dungeons. While exploring the dungeons, you will encounter enemies uniquely dangerous in different ways which you will have to learn to avoid and exploit if you want to survive to the deepest parts of the dungeons where the most valuable of treasures are protected.
A lot inside the dungeon that is found will be of value, and the deeper you get into the dungeon the more valuable treasures. You must make the strategic choice to either go safe and fill your hands with the less valuable, less guarded treasures in the first levels of the dungeon, or ignore those petty gems and risk diving deep into the dungeon for a better payoff. Do prepare yourself for the consequences that follows of taking these treasures though, it upsets the monsters and the more you manage to steal from them, the harder they will retaliate at nightfall.



With the endless abyss of the dungeon, don't be fooled to think there will only be the same types of monsters. You will often face challenging situations, especially the boss fights. (We are currently working hard on implementing all the unique monsters we have drafted, but all of them will not be implemented in the early access of the game).

With the unique collections of monsters that will appear, from cowardly monsters that only attack when they outnumber you and prefer to throw stuff at you and try and steal your equipment and treasures, to scary stalkers climbing the dungeon roofs trying to fool you by mimicking your friends voice and striking when it has you exactly where it wants you to be, we ensure a thrilling experience.



As the day progresses, you have to prepare yourself for the night. The ever emerging horde of monsters will not let you rest. If you are plundering their home, it is also their chance now to plunder yours. Defend yourself as good as possible, because the horde will not leave you alone during the night.

content_descriptors.notes: Mild violence since there will be fighting against monsters.

name: Bespoken
short_description: Bespoken is a Co-op Roguelike, RPG based game where you delve into monster filled dungeons, escape with treasures, get resources, build your own fort and protect it against the monsters!
